text: I think you'd really enjoy this hummus recipe, given your fondness for beans and your goal of increasing your protein intake. As a vegan, you'll appreciate that it's free from animal products, and the high protein content from the garbanzo beans will help you meet your health goal. The recipe is also quick to make, taking only about 10 minutes to prepare, which fits within your time budget. Overall, it's a nutritious and tasty option that aligns with your dietary preferences and requirements.
